provenance.scope: Privacy-safe agent endpoint telemetry, synthetic-test separation, AI-referral attribution, and reporting rules.

privacy.notes: Durable agent analytics stores event type, service, path, method, normalized crawler family, traffic class, synthetic monitor source, Cloudflare country/colo when available, and tool/resource names. It does not store inquiry body content, names, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, raw user-agent strings, credentials, or secrets.

trafficClasses.synthetic: DesertScape validation, monitoring, smoke tests, or readiness checks. Exclude from organic KPIs.
trafficClasses.recognized-crawler: A normalized public crawler or AI retrieval user agent.
trafficClasses.human-or-unknown: A request that is neither a DesertScape monitor nor a recognized crawler.
trafficClasses.legacy-unclassified: Events written before the 2026-07-21 traffic-class cutover. Report separately and never relabel as organic.

organicDashboard.legacyPolicy: Rows with empty blob10 predate the cutover and must appear only as legacy-unclassified.
kpis: organic MCP requests and tool calls
AI-attributed phone, WhatsApp, form, and qualified-lead events

aiReferralAttribution.privacy: Session-scoped attribution only. No personal information is added.

latestEvidence.interpretation: This snapshot proves endpoint retrieval and recognized crawler activity. It does not prove an AI citation, recommendation, referral, conversion, or qualified lead. Synthetic monitoring is excluded from the organic figures.

currentDashboards.name: GA4 AI Referral and Lead Attribution
currentDashboards.scope: AI referral sessions and AI-attributed phone, WhatsApp, email, form, and qualified inquiry events

recommendedQueries: Use blob10 to exclude synthetic events from every organic KPI.
Report empty blob10 rows as legacy-unclassified; do not infer that they were organic.
Group recognized-crawler rows by blob5 and blob1 to measure real crawler retrieval behavior.
Group organic mcp_tool_call and inquiry_prepare rows by blob8 to measure agent engagement.
Report synthetic rows by blob11 to monitor test coverage without mixing them into growth metrics.
Join interpretation, not user identity, across Cloudflare endpoint events and GA4 AI-referral conversions.
